description.p: KPeek brings Quick Look to KDE's file manager. Select a file in Dolphin, press Meta+Space, and a preview appears. Use the arrow keys to move through the folder, and press the shortcut again to close it.

ul.li: Images, including HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, SVG and animated GIF and WebP
PDF documents and comic books (CBZ, CBR, CB7, CBT)
Office documents, from the preview picture stored in the document
Source code and text with syntax highlighting, and rendered Markdown
The contents of zip, tar, 7z, RAR, ISO and other archives

description.p: Everything else shows Dolphin's thumbnail and the file's details. KPeek opens files read-only, never accesses the network, and stays light on memory.
To open KPeek from Dolphin, install the "KPeek" service menu from Dolphin's Settings, Configure Dolphin, Context Menu, Download New Services, or follow the instructions on the project page.
The window can be resized from its top edge and top corners too.

ul.li: KPeek quits when you close a preview: nothing stays running in the background
A borderless preview window: drag the header bar to move it, drag its edges to resize it
Previews images, PDFs, comic books, office documents, video and audio, text and code, Markdown, 3D models, archives and fonts
Zoom with Ctrl and the mouse wheel or the header buttons, and pan by dragging
Moves through the selection or the whole folder with the arrow keys
